Malle ERW Bayesian Treatment Comparison Plots

Regenerated from saved Bayesian model fits

This report regenerates the forest, violin, and Hühnerberg dose-response plots using the saved CmdStan model fits and the integrated dataset.

1 1. Load packages, data, and saved model fits

Saved model fits loaded: 52 
Responses available in integrated dataset: 54

2 2. Reconstruct posterior treatment contrasts from saved fits

The original model standardized each response using its mean and standard deviation across the observations included in that response’s model. This section reconstructs the posterior treatment means and primary treatment-minus- Control contrasts from each stored fit’s mu draws.

3 3. Primary forest plots (standardized units)

These use the same plot structure as the original script: treatment contrasts versus Control, 95% credible intervals, no significance stars.
